summary: English virtual-only development review passed: combined morphology/metabolic evidence with narrow identification claims, direct manipulation, original learning reports and retained corrections. External/classroom/hardware/translation and release acceptance separate.

G01.notes: Shape, controlled metabolic readouts and limited inference each have actual student observations/checks and original goal-linked explanations; a reference match is not species proof or mastery.

G02.notes: One unknown, one field and plus/minus glucose answer distinct questions. Supplied positive/blank references and optional matched second preparation remove redundant setup without copying observations or claiming independent cultures.

G03.notes: OpenStax 22.2 and ASM fermentation method read. All four synthetic fermenter profiles verified; acid/gas differ, filled inverted collector traps gas at top, shape cannot establish a species or distinguish every bacterial/archaeal domain.

G04.notes: Synthetic reference set, illustrated field/supplied scale, shortened growth, detection limits, pure-model sample and narrow identification claims are explained in workflow, report and handouts. No physical recipe or oxygen assay.

G05.notes: Slide placement, continuous focus, shape classification, U pipette placement, paired readout recording and joint profile selection cause visible changes and supply required evidence.

G06.notes: Original microscope/slide, clear/blurred scaled field and liquid-filled/gas-displaced glass collectors inspected on desktop, tablet and phone at initial/intermediate/final states. Spatial targets align; text supplements visual observations.

G07.notes: Fixed profile and field orientation, seeded choices and saved observations persist on reload. All four actual outcomes work; meaningful profile order remains fixed for comparison, with no forced gas-positive result.

G08.notes: Full authored pathway and resources manually read; necessary terms defined. Replaced student-facing uninoculated/acidify with plain language. Core heuristic around grade 8 is diagnostic, not student comprehension approval.

G09.notes: Model/UI enforce first prediction/design before results, loaded/clear field before shape check, confirmed shape before broths, both preparations before growth, readouts before match, and confirmed reference before concept checks.

G10.notes: Explicit Correct!/Try again, meaningful correction flags and retained current unconfirmed entries. Edited shape/readout/profile clears stale feedback and gates; sample remains stable.

G11.notes: Actual browser checks confirm successful save/repeat/reload, denied storage/retry and identity versus academic edits; no false cloud submission or grading claims.

G12.notes: Root-scoped versioned attempt retains original plan, profile/field, matched preparation sources, raw current selections, checks/corrections and writing. Viewing focus preserves checked evidence; substantive edits clear completion.

G13.notes: Downloaded completed named/neutral drafts and native print include optional name/period, safe filenames, readable local date/time/zone and honest completion status.

G14.notes: One snapshot carries predictions, observed shape, current color/gas with confirmation, preparation provenance, limited profile match, corrections and original goal-linked writing. Internal source IDs stay in JSON rather than human narrative.

G15.notes: All 33 final resource/report pages rendered and inspected, including long Unicode/native print/final marker. First offline exports, neutral drafts, failure recovery and PDF/print/JSON fidelity exercised.

G16.notes: Mouse placement after resize/scroll, keyboard slide/select/focus, native touch drag-release-next-tap and continuous range adjustment, 44px targets, phone/tablet and reduced motion pass. Real devices/AT remain pending.
